original_value: Compact standalone field recorder for creators who need quick capture of interviews, ambient sound, and voice notes. The Drift 32GB pairs a built-in stereo microphone array with USB-C direct transfer, onboard file indexing, and simple one-touch recording controls. Designed for pocket carry and low-power operation, it stores hours of high-bitrate audio without relying on a phone or computer.
